spans.claim: James Meredith was found dead with a revolver in his right hand and a bullet wound in his left temple
spans.anchor: A bullet had entered just below the left temple, and there was a mark of powder near the face
spans.span: A bullet had entered just below the left temple, and there was a mark of powder near the face.

spans.claim: Jean Briggerland's testimony was crucial in Meredith's conviction
spans.anchor: The evidence of Miss Briggerland that you had threatened this poor young man
spans.span: The evidence of Miss Briggerland that you had threatened this poor young man, and that you left her presence in a temper, is unshaken.

spans.claim: Meredith escaped from a nursing home and married Lydia Beale
spans.anchor: He escaped from the nursing home last night and at this particular moment is in this house
spans.span: He escaped from the nursing home last night and at this particular moment is in this house.

spans.claim: Jean Briggerland and her father conspired against Lydia Meredith
spans.anchor: I am as anxious as you are to get to the bottom of this dreadful tragedy
spans.span: I am as anxious as you are to get to the bottom of this dreadful tragedy.

spans.claim: François Mordon forged Lydia Meredith's signature and drew money from her bank
spans.anchor: I have returned from London and have confessed to Madame Meredith that I have forged her name and have drawn £100,000 from her bank
spans.span: _I have returned from London and have confessed to Madame Meredith that I have forged her name and have drawn £100,000 from her bank.

spans.anchor: Mr. Briggerland, it seemed, had some other object in life than the regeneration of the criminal classes
spans.span: Chapter XII Mr. Briggerland, it seemed, had some other object in life than the regeneration of the criminal classes.

spans.claim: Lydia Meredith's bed was soaked with peroxide to disinfect it after infection
spans.anchor: Her bed's sopping... They must have poured buckets of water over it, and used up all Mrs. Cole-Mortimer's peroxide

spans.claim: Jack Glover disguised himself as old Jaggs to protect Lydia Meredith
spans.anchor: I have not left Monte Carlo since Lydia Meredith arrived
spans.span: that I am Jack Glover, and that I have not left Monte Carlo since Lydia Meredith arrived.

spans.claim: The forged letter was part of a story dictated by Jean Briggerland
spans.anchor: The story! Mademoiselle Briggerland told me she was writing a story, and I remember she said she had writer's cramp
spans.span: The story! Mademoiselle Briggerland told me she was writing a story, and I remember she said she had writer's cramp.

spans.claim: Jean Briggerland burnt the manuscript of her story to hide evidence
spans.anchor: She carried the paper to a remote corner of the grounds and burnt it sheet by sheet
spans.span: The remainder, including all that part of the story she had written on the previous night, she made into a bundle, and when Lydia had gone off with Marcus Stepney to swim, she carried the paper to a remote corner of the grounds and burnt it sheet by sheet.

spans.claim: Mr. Briggerland was arrested for the murder of François Mordon
spans.anchor: I have a warrant from the Préfect of the Alpes Maritimes for your arrest
spans.span: M'sieur Briggerland, I have a warrant from the Préfect of the Alpes Maritimes for your arrest.

spans.claim: Lydia Meredith was attacked and thrown into the sea but rescued by Marcus Stepney
spans.anchor: The bullet ripped her hat from her head, and she flung up her hands, thinking she had been struck
spans.span: The bullet ripped her hat from her head, and she flung up her hands, thinking she had been struck.

spans.claim: Marcus Stepney and Jean Briggerland fled by motor-launch to escape arrest
spans.anchor: The _Jungle Queen_ had called at Malaga, had provisioned, refilled, and put out to sea again
spans.span: Briggerland had undergone his preliminary examination, when a wire came through from the Spanish police that a motor-boat answering the description of the _Jungle Queen_ had called at Malaga, had provisioned, refilled, and put out to sea again, before the police authorities, who had a description of the pair, had time to investigate.

spans.claim: Jean Briggerland met Muley Hafiz, the Moorish Pretender
spans.anchor: He might have been a European; his complexion was fair, though his eyebrows and eyes were jet black
spans.span: He might have been a European; his complexion was fair, though his eyebrows and eyes were jet black, as also was the tiny beard and moustache he wore.

spans.claim: Jean Briggerland planned to marry François Mordon
spans.anchor: François and I are going to be married next week

spans.claim: Jack Glover exposed the conspiracy and protected Lydia Meredith
spans.anchor: I have sufficient evidence to secure the arrest of your father, and possibly yourself
spans.span: I have sufficient evidence to secure the arrest of your father, and possibly yourself.

spans.claim: The shooting at San Remo was committed by Mr. Briggerland, not Mordon
spans.anchor: You think that all these time she has been trying to kill me? She has used everybody, even me

spans.claim: The forged cheque was presented in London and honored
spans.anchor: This cheque is in order. Please honour
spans.span: This cheque is in order. Please honour.

spans.claim: The conspiracy involved multiple attempts on Lydia Meredith's life
spans.anchor: I not only suggest it, but I state positively that there have been four attempts on your life in the past fortnight
spans.span: I not only suggest it, but I state positively that there have been four attempts on your life in the past fortnight," he said calmly.
